errors.E_ENCODING: Invalid UTF-8 source or import encoding.
errors.E_LIMIT: A named resource limit was exceeded.
errors.E_BLOCK_EMPTY: Conditional/detail block contains no renderable content.
errors.E_DECLARATION_SCOPE: Root-only declaration used in a nested block.
errors.E_PROPERTY_DEPENDENCY: Option depends on another missing option.
errors.E_PROPERTY_VALUE: Option has an invalid literal value.
errors.E_NAME_DUPLICATE: Document name declared more than once.
errors.E_ROW_SCOPE: row.field used outside a supported row context.
errors.E_COLUMN_UNKNOWN: Referenced table column does not exist.
errors.E_TYPE: Types do not satisfy an operator/directive/function contract.
errors.E_NUMBER_RANGE: Numeric operation produced a non-finite/non-real result.
errors.E_EMPTY_MEAN: Mean requested for an empty table/view.
errors.E_STATE_DOMAIN: Control update/default violates its allowed domain.
errors.E_DATA_HEADER: Invalid or duplicate typed table header.
errors.E_DATA_ARITY: Row cell count differs from the schema.
errors.E_DATA_VALUE: Cell is not a valid scalar for its declared type.
errors.E_CHART_SERIES: Invalid series count/form for chart type.
errors.E_CHART_VALUE: Invalid chart datum, e.g. negative sector value.
errors.E_CHART_DOMAIN: Finite chart geometry cannot be constructed.
errors.E_SELECTION_DOMAIN: Chart x cannot be represented by the linked control.
errors.E_ASSET_MISSING: Referenced local image was not supplied.
errors.E_ASSET_PATH: Unsafe resource or ZIP entry path.
errors.E_BUNDLE: Malformed bundle, duplicate keys/entries, CRC or manifest mismatch.
errors.E_HASH_MISMATCH: Source/resource hash does not match its envelope.
errors.E_SNAPSHOT: State envelope does not match source/schema/controls.
errors.E_EXPORT_INVALID: Export requested for invalid/stale source or an invalid state.
errors.E_OUTPUT_EXISTS: Output already exists and replacement is not authorized.
errors.E_WORKER_TIMEOUT: Worker did not complete before the watchdog.
errors.E_PROTOCOL: Malformed or unauthorized host protocol message; stale valid results are ignored.
errors.E_INTERNAL: Unexpected engine fault; not a document syntax diagnosis.

warnings.W_NUL_REPLACED: NUL displayed as the replacement character.
warnings.W_HTML_INERT: Raw author HTML displayed as text.
warnings.W_LINK_LOCAL_UNSUPPORTED: Local document navigation is not implemented.
